records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Willow Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three outreach emails (email:75c99d01, email:be9d41c3, email:f0d4caae) and no tickets at all. Total silence plus no setup progress suggests low self-serve momentum in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One small step to get Willow Partners started
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

I know a new tool is easy to put off, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in is usually the moment things click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
